authenticity_review: The image exhibits high perceptual quality with realistic studio lighting, soft shadows, and appropriate depth of field. The Router-identified artifacts (center giraffe leg fusion, right giraffe seam misalignment) are plausible manufacturing defects rather than AI generation failures, supporting authenticity. No graphics-level distortions (noise, blur, compression) were detected by the perceptual auditor. The auxiliary mask shows clean segmentation boundaries, further indicating structural coherence.
